text: Summary of changes - Implemented automatic linkification of plain URLs in notes. Notes now render plain URLs (e.g., https://github.com) as clickable links without requiring Markdown link syntax. - Added a unit test to reproduce and verify the behavior. What I changed - In bookmarks/templatetags/shared.py, updated the markdown rendering tag to post-process the rendered HTML with bleach.linkify before sanitizing: - Convert markdown to HTML as before - Run bleach.linkify on the HTML to turn plain URLs into anchor tags - Sanitize the result with bleach.clean using the existing allowlist Why this approach - The project already uses python-markdown for Markdown and bleach for sanitization. - bleach.linkify safely detects URLs/emails in HTML text and wraps them in anchors. It respects existing tags and, by default, skips linkifying inside certain tags (e.g., code/pre), and doesn’t rewrite existing anchors. - We still sanitize the output after linkification using the existing bleach allowlist, preserving the security model and allowed tags/attributes. Tests added - In bookmarks/tests/test_bookmarks_list_template.py, added: - test_autolink_plain_url_in_notes: creates a bookmark with notes containing a plain URL and asserts that the rendered HTML contains an anchor with the correct href. - All tests (including the new one) pass: - Ran pytest: 802 tests passed, 1 warning. Manual verification - Create or edit a bookmark and put a note like: “Visit https://github.com for more info” - Open the bookmark list or details page; in the notes section, the URL should be rendered as a clickable link. Scope - This change affects notes rendering, which is where Markdown is supported in the UI. Descriptions are rendered as plain text, so they are not affected. If you also want automatic linkification in descriptions, we can similarly apply bleach.linkify where descriptions are rendered. Security considerations - Output continues to be sanitized with bleach.clean and the existing bleach_allowlist, so unsafe tags/attributes are still removed/escaped. - Only linkification was added in-between Markdown render and sanitization.
